seed: The Icons guide Start on an icon frame, for somebody at the defaults: keylines are on from the start, so the keylines step arrives already done. The card says they are already on and offers Next, rather than telling the person to choose the menu row that would switch them off. Pressing Next moves on and leaves the keylines drawn.

steps.note: the guide opened a page of its own with nothing on it, so the frame you are about to make is the only thing on it
the card sends you to Layer, New Frame. It waits for the sheet rather than for a Next press
THE TEST: opening the sheet moved the guide on by itself, and the card is pointing at the sheet, so it sits BESIDE the size list rather than on top of it
a 24 by 24 frame, with the camera gone to get it, and the preview squares in the corner of the canvas

steps.comment: THE TEST: keylines were on before the guide began, so the card says so and offers Next. It names no menu row, because choosing the row would switch them off.

steps.note: the keylines are drawn on the frame and the card says they are already on, with Next

steps.comment: An already-done step never moves on by itself: the person reads it and presses Next.

steps.note: Next moved on and the keylines are still drawn
